import sys

def main():
    a = float(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    b = float(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    x = int(a)
    y = int(b)
    
    and_result = x & y
    or_result = x | y
    xor_result = x ^ y
    not_and_result = (~x) & y
    
    print(f"Bitwise AND result: {and_result}")
    print(f"Bitwise OR result: {or_result}")
    print(f"Bitwise XOR result: {xor_result}")
    print(f"Bitwise NOT and AND result: {not_and_result}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
